youtube.baslik: How many decibels does a microphone near the talker's mouth gain? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: A remote microphone sits about 15 centimeters from the talker's mouth. Compared with a listener two meters away, this means a signal about 22 decibels stronger in a free field, because the level drops by about 6 decibels each time distance doubles. This gain is one of the most effective ways to lift speech above the noise in a noisy classroom.
